mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notification (id, recipient_id, actor_id, notification_type, target_type, target_id, title, content, dedupe_key, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{recipientId}, #{actorId}, #{notificationType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{dedupeKey}, #{readAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: n.id, n.recipient_id, n.actor_id, actor.username AS actor_username, actor.display_name AS actor_display_name, actor.avatar_url AS actor_avatar_url, n.notification_type, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.title, n.content, n.read_at, n.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT notification_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_notification WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL GROUP BY notification_type
mapper.update: UPDATE user_notification SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, #{readAt}) WHERE id = #{id} AND recipient_id = #{recipientId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, participant_low_id, participant_high_id, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at FROM direct_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND (participant_low_id = #{userId} OR participant_high_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO direct_conversation (id, participant_low_id, participant_high_id, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{participantLowId}, #{participantHighId}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, other.id AS other_user_id, other.username AS other_username, other.display_name AS other_display_name, other.avatar_url AS other_avatar_url, last_message.content AS last_message_content, last_message.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, c.last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM direct_message unread WHERE unread.conversation_id = c.id AND unread.recipient_id = #{userId} AND unread.read_at IS NULL) AS unread_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM direct_conversation c JOIN app_user other ON other.id = CASE WHEN c.participant_low_id = #{userId} THEN c.participant_high_id ELSE c.participant_low_id END LEFT JOIN direct_message last_message ON last_message.id = ( SELECT latest.id FROM direct_message latest WHERE latest.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY latest.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.participant_low_id = #{userId} OR c.participant_high_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM direct_conversation WHERE participant_low_id = #{userId} OR participant_high_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE direct_conversation SET last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt}, updated_at = #{lastMessageAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO direct_message (id, conversation_id, sender_id, recipient_id, client_message_id, content, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{recipientId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{content}, #{readAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, sender.username AS sender_username, sender.display_name AS sender_display_name, sender.avatar_url AS sender_avatar_url, m.recipient_id, m.client_message_id, m.content, m.read_at, m.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM direct_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM direct_message WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE direct_message SET read_at = #{readAt} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL
